name: Nami
source: The priestess who presided over the ritual 12 years ago and the one who tried to sacrifice Kitami. In a fit of insanity after she was unable to open the Gate of Orkus, Nami murdered all the other members of the Rose Cross club in an attempt to summon the devil, before she was killed by Kitami herself.
